ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits, Vol. 1 and 2; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist, I cannot tell whether this fits my current rock and metal interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: Animals; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: If this is Pink Floyd, its progressive sound appeals to my interest in Tool.
ItemID: NA; Title: Black Sabbath; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Heavy riffs and a dark atmosphere fit my recent metal listening; I would try this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for heavier guitar music rather than vocal pop right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Relaxed blues rock is less appealing than the heavier music I currently want.
ItemID: NA; Title: 50 Number Ones; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little reason to choose it over a recognizable rock album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Simon & Garfunkel The Best Of; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Folk harmonies do not match my current appetite for hard rock and metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Feels Like Home; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot identify the artist from this title and would pass without a clearer connection to my taste.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hotel California; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I might enjoy the Eagles another time, but I want something heavier today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Master of Reality; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its heavy, riff-driven sound makes it my strongest choice given my recent metal listening.
